name: Aster House
blurb: Courtyard living with deep verandas and cross-ventilated rooms.
body:
Courtyard living with deep verandas and cross-ventilated rooms.

The brief for Aster House asked for a residential project that responds to its setting in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. We planned it around light, views and everyday movement, then built it with our own crews.

Materials were chosen to age well on site, and the same team stayed with the project from first sketch to handover in 2024.
